learning_objective: 🎯 Learn the ninja trick of flipping sentences to focus on the action or the receiver instead of the doer!

main_concepts.concept_title: 🦸‍♂️ Active Voice (The Doer is the Hero)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In an Active sentence, the Subject performs the action. It is direct and powerful! Example: 'The cat (Subject) chased the mouse (Object).' The cat is the hero doing the action.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🎯 Passive Voice (The Receiver is the Hero)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: In a Passive sentence, we flip it! The Object becomes the star of the sentence, and the Subject is pushed to the end. Example: 'The mouse (New Subject) was chased by the cat.' The meaning is exactly the same, but the focus changes.

main_concepts.concept_title: 🔄 The Flipping Rule (How to change voice)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Step 1: Swap the Subject and the Object. Step 2: Add a helping verb like 'is, am, are, was, or were'. Step 3: Always change the main verb to its 3rd form (Past Participle). Step 4: Add the word 'by' before the doer. Example: 'Rahul kicked the ball' becomes 'The ball was kicked by Rahul.'

When you flip a sentence, pronouns have to change their costume! 'I' becomes 'by me', 'He' becomes 'by him', 'She' becomes 'by her', and 'They' becomes 'by them'. 'We won the match' becomes 'The match was won by us.'

main_concepts.concept_title: 👻 When to use Passive Voice? (The Mystery Doer)
main_concepts.simple_explanation: Why use Passive at all? We use it when we do not know WHO did the action, or it is not important. Example: 'My bicycle was stolen!' We don't know who stole it, so we make the bicycle the hero of the sentence.

fun_activity.title: 🕵️‍♂️ The Sentence Flipper
fun_activity.instructions: Take these three active sentences and flip them into passive voice! 1) The dog ate the homework. 2) The teacher praised the student. 3) My mom baked a cake.

quick_recap: ⭐ Active Voice: Subject does the action (Subject + Verb + Object).
⭐ Passive Voice: Subject receives the action (Object + Helping Verb + V3 + by + Subject).
⭐ In Passive voice, the main verb is ALWAYS in the 3rd form (Past Participle).
⭐ Use Passive voice when the focus is on the action itself, or the doer is unknown.
